style_prefix: found footage still from a dusty analog VHS camcorder tape, 1990s home video
style_suffix: washed out desaturated colors, muted sickly green-yellow cast, grainy low resolution, soft focus, harsh on-camera flash, liminal empty interior, off-center framing, landscape 4:3 composition
prompt_guidance: Shoot every scene like a handheld analog camcorder frame: eye-level or slightly low angle, a wide shot with deep empty space, subject small or half hidden, nothing glamorous. Prefer fluorescent-lit corridors, empty rooms, closed doors and thresholds. Keep the unsettling element ambiguous, partially obscured, at the edge of the frame or far in the background, never a clear close-up of a monster. Describe only what the camera sees, in plain concrete terms.
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, clean, professional photography, illustration, cartoon, 3d render, pastel colors

entities.The Watcher: a tall thin pale figure with an elongated smooth face, no eyes, long arms hanging to its knees, wearing a faded grey raincoat
entities.The Hallway: an endless narrow hallway with yellowed wallpaper, stained beige carpet, flickering fluorescent ceiling lights and many identical closed doors
entities.The Door: a plain wooden door painted dull teal, peeling paint, a brass handle, slightly ajar with darkness behind it
